company.shortDescription: Playabl is an AI-powered, no-code platform for creating web games and interactive experiences by chatting in plain text.
company.description: Playabl is an AI-powered platform for creating web games and interactive experiences through natural language chat. The product lets users describe game ideas in plain text and generates playable browser-based drafts with core loops, controls, user interface, and starter content. Creators can refine difficulty, rules, level layouts, visuals, and pacing by iterating in a conversational interface rather than writing code or configuring a separate engine. The platform also supports remixing existing games, publishing playables via shareable links, and using templates to avoid starting from a blank project. Built-in tools cover asset generation, basic 3D modeling, animation presets, and visual customization to support a range of desktop-style games, mobile-first prototypes, playable ads, and lightweight interactive web experiences.
